search.name: Search
search.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Search gives +2 on Survival checks when following tracks. Active tactile inspection of 5-ft squares.

actions.name: Inspect 5-Foot Square or Container
actions.description: Examine a chest, stone block, or floor tile for concealed compartments, hidden mechanisms, or traps.

actions.name: Detect Concealed or Secret Door
actions.description: Detect subtle seams, hidden hinges, or hollow mortar revealing a disguised passageway.
